questions.q: What is the Spanish word for 'pen' that this course teaches?
options: el cuaderno
el bolígrafo
el borrador
la regla
questions.explanation: El bolígrafo is 'pen.' In Mexico and much of Central America many people say la pluma instead — both are correct.

questions.q: Which list has the correct little word for 'the' on all three?
options: la cuaderno, la bolígrafo, la borrador
el regla, el pizarra, el computadora
la regla, la pizarra, la computadora
el regla, la cuaderno, el pizarra
questions.explanation: La regla, la pizarra, and la computadora take la. El cuaderno, el bolígrafo, el escritorio, and el borrador take el. Learn the el or la as part of the word.

questions.q: Your teacher tells the whole class, 'Escuchen.' What should you do?
options: Raise your hand
Take out your notebook
Listen
Look at the board
questions.explanation: Escuchen means 'listen.' Levanten la mano means 'raise your hand,' and saquen el cuaderno means 'take out your notebook.'

questions.q: How should you treat command phrases like 'saquen el cuaderno' and 'levanten la mano' this week?
options: As whole phrases to recognize and follow
As words to translate one at a time
As phrases you must be able to change for one person
As words that only appear in writing, never out loud
questions.explanation: Learn them as fixed classroom phrases, like knowing 'line up' as one idea. Building and changing commands yourself comes later in the year.

questions.q: A written instruction card says, 'Recorta el dibujo.' What does recorta tell you to do?
options: Draw the picture
Write the picture's name
Color the picture
Cut out the picture
questions.explanation: Recorta means 'cut out.' Dibuja means 'draw' and escribe means 'write.'

questions.q: Which sentence correctly says 'On the desk there is a notebook'?
options: En el escritorio hay un cuaderno.
En el cuaderno hay un escritorio.
En el escritorio hay una cuaderno.
En la computadora hay un cuaderno.
questions.explanation: Hay means 'there is.' Cuaderno is an el word, so it takes un, not una: hay un cuaderno.
